newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Tower tops annual NZ funds management awards.
newsitem.headline: Tower tops annual NZ funds management awards.

text.p: Tower Financial Services Group has been named fund manager of the year at the sixth annual IPAC New Zealand Funds Management Industry Awards.
The awards, conducted by the investment strategy and funds management research company IPAC, and were held last night.
Tower, which incorporates Tower Portfolio Management, also won the award in 1996.
IPAC said in a statement the premier award was given to the New Zealand-based funds management company rated most highly by its research process.
General manager David van Schaardenburg said fund managers were short-listed and assessed on the calibre of their people, decision making processes, investment portfolios and past performance.
"It's not a number crunching exercise, more the building of a rounded picture of all aspects of an organisation's investment capabilities combined with trends in achieved performances," he said.
Also announced were the annual awards for the best fund managers in each of 11 categories of funds management.
Individual categories were won (some jointly) by Tower, 2, AMP, 3, BNZ, 1, Guardian Trust, 2, National Mutual, 2, Prudential, 1, ANZ 1, Bankers Trust, 2, and Norwich Union, 1.

Van Schaardenburg said the upcoming superannuation referendum had intensified New Zealanders' attention on the need to provide for their own retirement and the importance of doing so via better quality solutions offered by the funds management industry.
